description: Frontend host activation + 'Demo Users' admin screen + nginx routing + OAuth redirect-URI documentation. Adds isDemoHost() and host-forced ROLE_XAMOPS activation in demoConfig.ts, a 'Demo Users' sidebar sibling after Accounts with its route and page fetching GET /api/billops/admin/demo-users, extends nginx server_name to include demo.xamops.com, and documents the external OAuth redirect-URI registration. The frontend/nginx work is independent of the backend FEATs; the admin page consumes FEAT-004's endpoint so this FEAT is sequenced last. Keep demoRouter tests green.
steps: Extend /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/frontend-app/src/demo/demoConfig.ts: add `export function isDemoHost(): boolean` that reads a guarded `(import.meta as any)?.env?.VITE_DEMO_HOST` override inside a try/catch (compare hostname to the trimmed override when set) and otherwise returns `window.location.hostname === 'demo.xamops.com'`. Extend `activateDemoModeIfNeeded(email)` so `const hostForced = isDemoHost();` forces role 'ROLE_XAMOPS' for ANY email when hostForced, else uses the existing allowlist role; keep the existing localStorage.clear() + sessionStorage sets. Do NOT change the existing exports DEMO_MODE_KEY, DEMO_ROLE_KEY, isDemoMode, getDemoRole, DEMO_EMAILS (demoRouter.test.ts depends on the keys).

Confirm (no edit expected) that both activateDemoModeIfNeeded call sites in /Users/admin/.../frontend-app/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx and the call in /Users/admin/.../frontend-app/src/components/Login/LoginForm.tsx already pass the profile email — since host-forcing now lives inside activateDemoModeIfNeeded, both activate host demo mode automatically. If a call site does NOT already call activateDemoModeIfNeeded on the demo-host path, add the minimal call; otherwise leave them unchanged.

Confirm (no edit) that /Users/admin/.../frontend-app/src/demo/demoRouter.ts PASSTHROUGH_PATTERNS still contains /api/auth/, /logout, /api/xamops/user/profile, /api/billops/profile so the header shows the user's own identity.

In /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/frontend-app/src/App.tsx insert `'demo-users': '/billops-admin-demo-users',` into the BILLOPS_ADMIN_TAB_ROUTES object literal IMMEDIATELY AFTER `'client-details': '/billops-client-details',` (this single edit also positions it in BILLOPS_ADMIN_TAB_ORDER = Object.keys(...)), and add `<Route path="/billops-admin-demo-users" element={<BillOpsAdminDemoUsersPage />} />` next to the other billops-admin routes, with the page import mirroring how ClientDetailsPage/BillOpsAdminDashboardPage are imported. demoRouter.test.ts stays green (demoConfig public exports unchanged).

findings: Implemented in the worktree (branch feature/demo-xamops-host). demoConfig.ts: added `export function isDemoHost()` — reads a guarded (import.meta as any)?.env?.VITE_DEMO_HOST override inside try/catch (compares hostname to the trimmed override when set, else to the literal 'demo.xamops.com'); extended activateDemoModeIfNeeded(email) so `const hostForced = isDemoHost()` forces role 'ROLE_XAMOPS' for ANY email on the demo host, otherwise falls back to the DEMO_EMAILS allowlist; kept localStorage.clear()+sessionStorage sets. Public exports DEMO_MODE_KEY/DEMO_ROLE_KEY/isDemoMode/getDemoRole/DEMO_EMAILS unchanged, so demoRouter.test.ts stays green. CALL SITES CONFIRMED (no edit): AuthContext.tsx (both profile-load paths) and LoginForm.tsx already pass the profile email to activateDemoModeIfNeeded, so host-forcing now activates automatically on the demo host. PASSTHROUGH confirmed (no edit): demoRouter.ts PASSTHROUGH_PATTERNS still has /api/auth/, /logout, /api/xamops/user/profile, /api/billops/profile. Sidebar.tsx: added a 'Demo Users' NavItem immediately after the Accounts item, gated by isTabAllowed('demo-users'), href=/billops-admin-demo-users, icon fas fa-user-clock. App.tsx: inserted 'demo-users': '/billops-admin-demo-users' into BILLOPS_ADMIN_TAB_ROUTES right after 'client-details' (also positions it in BILLOPS_ADMIN_TAB_ORDER), lazy import of BillOpsAdminDemoUsersPage, and <Route path="/billops-admin-demo-users" .../> next to the other billops-admin routes. Did NOT add 'demo-users' to BILLOPS_ADMIN_TABS in MyProfilePage.tsx (primary-admin-only for v1). New page BillOpsAdminDemoUsersPage.tsx: read-only table (admin-page conventions, billopsAdminDashboard.css) fetching GET /api/billops/admin/demo-users with credentials:'include'; columns Email, Name (displayName), Auth Provider, First Seen, Last Login, Login Count, Last IP; null/absent fields render as em-dash, loginCount defaults 0; loading/empty/error states; no write actions. New test demoConfig.test.ts: isDemoHost() true for demo.xamops.com / false otherwise / honours (and trims) VITE_DEMO_HOST; activateDemoModeIfNeeded forces ROLE_XAMOPS on the demo host for any email and preserves the allowlist mapping on the live host. The test stubs window.location.hostname via Object.defineProperty and installs an in-memory localStorage/sessionStorage, because the Node-25 test runtime exposes a localStorage whose methods are undefined (an environment quirk, not a product change). nginx-prod.conf: changed `server_name live.xamops.com;` to `server_name live.xamops.com demo.xamops.com;` (single server block; no location/header/upstream change; no X-Forwarded-Host) and added a comment documenting the external console task (register the two demo callback URLs). GoogleOAuthService.java / MicrosoftOAuthService.java: comment-only note near the redirect-uri field that https://demo.xamops.com/api/auth/{google,microsoft}/callback must be registered in Google Cloud / Microsoft Entra; no behavior change. VERIFICATION: frontend-app `npm run build` -> SUCCESS (icons:bundle + tsc + vite build, no TS errors). `npx vitest run src/demo` -> 10 files / 213 tests pass (new demoConfig.test.ts + demoRouter.test.ts green). Full `npm test` -> 1588 pass / 8 fail; all 8 failures are a pre-existing environment quirk (Node-25 experimental localStorage shadowing jsdom -> 'localStorage.setItem/clear is not a function' from ThemeContext/AuthContext) and reproduce identically on the unmodified parent workspace for the same test files (cloudk8sSidebar, loginAsAccountDashboard, BillOpsAdminDashboardPage, EksDetailsPage); none touch the FEAT-005 files. `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl xamops-service -am` -> BUILD SUCCESS, 3417 run / 0 failures / 0 errors / 56 skipped (confirms the OAuth comment-only edit compiles and the DEMO_EMAILS set-equality tests stay green). nginx not installed locally, so verified by diff review (only server_name + comments changed). node_modules was symlinked from the parent workspace (identical package-lock.json) to run the frontend tooling; the symlink was removed before committing and the build artifacts (frontend-app/dist, public/version.json, src/icons/bundle.ts) were reverted so only source changes are committed.
